details.summary: This is an outstanding, zero-cook recipe that perfectly answers the book's mandate. It hits the necessary Mediterranean flavor profile, provides excellent complex carbohydrates and lean protein, and is easily achievable in 15 minutes with accessible supermarket staples.

dimensions.feedback: Flavors are very well balanced. The brininess of the olives, the bright acidity of the lemon and tomatoes, and the richness of the mackerel and olive oil create a classic, cohesive Mediterranean profile.
Every listed ingredient is used in the instructions, and no unlisted ingredients appear in the steps.
Instructions are clear and actionable. The direction to gently fold the mixture to avoid turning the fish to paste is an excellent culinary detail for a no-cook assembly.
The recipe aligns perfectly with a Mediterranean diet style, using fish, legumes, olive oil, lemon, fresh herbs, and whole grains.
The no-cook, fresh assembly method is perfectly suited to these ingredients, creating a vibrant and textural cold lunch.

The macros reflect the ingredients accurately. The generous protein (39.5g) logically comes from the 8oz of mackerel plus the beans, while the carbs (53.9g) map perfectly to the 100g of pita, beans, and large tomatoes.
The title accurately reflects the main ingredients. The intro is warm, descriptive, and accurately conveys the zero-cook convenience without any banned dietary or medical claims.
This is a highly appealing, quick, and satisfying lunch that feels elevated but takes only minutes to put together.

Excellent execution of the book's dual-purpose spine. It supplies heart- and liver-healthy Omega-3s and monounsaturated fats alongside high-quality, blood-sugar-stabilizing complex carbohydrates and plenty of protein.
Zero added sugar is accurate. The carbohydrate count is perfect (53.9g against a 32-55g window), anchored solidly by high-quality whole-wheat pita and legumes to prevent hypoglycemia.
Fits the 'Lunches' chapter brief exactly: a no-cook, desk-friendly plate that holds up well, relies on pantry staples, and meets all nutrient-tier targets for a main lunch.

Easily achievable in 15 minutes. Canned mackerel, beans, and standard beefsteak tomatoes are accessible at any standard grocery store. Specifying no-salt-added cans works perfectly here to keep sodium down.
